title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes VI: the Smoothies gain their Fruits' text
notes: The last item of the designer's sixth Stinkyscape+ balance pass (#4440): "Rework such that the fruits aren't fused into them, rather it gains the effect of the fruits." S+ #17 Smoothie and #18 Large Smoothie draw their two (three) random Fruits as before, but `fuseRandomInto`'s new `asText` mints the Fruits' fusion as a definition kept by no card and gives the Smoothie its text through R1850000's record (`subsystems::fuse::mint_text_def`): it stays a Smoothie, no fusion, its name, price, rarity and art its own; played, it does each Fruit's effect in turn and plays no Fruit; its owner's view shows the Fruits' text (`CardView.copies`), the opponent's nothing (R4440006). Their fusing scripts are kept through v0.6.11d (R767000). Ruling R4440006.

player.title: Stinkyscape+ Balance Changes VI, the Smoothies
changes: Smoothie and Large Smoothie no longer fuse their Fruits in: each stays a Smoothie, shows its Fruits' text, and when played does each Fruit's effect in turn.
Playing a Smoothie is not a play of its Fruits.
